description: The portfolio's shared configuration, extended by name. It replaces three rules that were written here: `sborka conventions`, `kotlin toolchain` and `kotlinx`. The preset's sborka rule is the same rule with one addition — it names `io.github.youndie.sborka` as well as `ru.workinprogress.sborka`, because the plugin ids are moving and a rule naming one of them stops matching on the day this repository migrates, which would bring back exactly the quiet split the rule exists to prevent.
The Monday batch moves from 9am to 6am with the rest of the portfolio; nothing depended on the hour.

Automerge is a separate preset (`github>youndie/sborka:automerge-harness`) and is not extended: nothing merges itself here today. Its precondition holds — check.yaml runs on `pull_request` — so it can be added as its own change.

packageRules.description: Exposed core and jdbc go in as a single version.

Testcontainers and the Postgres driver are used by nothing but the tests, and verifying either means the same thing: bring up a container and run the suite against it. One PR is one such run instead of two.

Major updates get their own PR: they cannot be merged without looking. The move from sborka 0.1.x to 0.2.x brought two new lint rules that found six real holes — worth reading, not worth merging blind. Stricter than the preset, which labels majors and leaves them open; here they wait on the dashboard until somebody asks for the branch.
